Built from research/FUNDINGPIPS_RULES_2026-10-08.md (sha256 23129e6b9df15d618199fcdeea03a7f3f5aed0dd18a9aa91cbf40f1412522e88). FundingPips was editing its help pages on 2026-10-08; re-check before any purchase or live decision. Research only.

_meta.plan: 1 Step Flex, 2% daily-loss option, 100,000 USD (zeno's account, Phase 0 2026-10-08)
_meta.status: verified rule sheet (2026-10-08); fields tagged [U] are assumptions

tags.initial_capital: [VP 1SF] 100,000 USD is one of the listed sizes; zeno's account size from Phase 0
tags.profit_target_pct: [VP 1SF] 'Achieve a 12% profit target during Phase 1' = 12,000 USD on 100,000 USD
tags.daily_loss_pct: [VP 1SF, CMP] 2% (the configuration chosen at purchase; 3% is the alternative)
tags.daily_loss_base: [VP 1SF] 'day_start': the limit is a % of that day's baseline, not of the starting size
tags.day_start_reference: [VP 1SF] 'the system records both balance and equity ... Whichever is higher becomes the baseline' = max_balance_equity; floating P&L counts; [VP MECH] no intraday recalculation
tags.max_loss_pct: [VP 1SF] 'Max Loss Limit: 12% of the starting account size ... does not reset'; floor 88,000 USD
tags.max_loss_mode: [VP 1SF] static in substance (fixed at the starting size); the word 'static' is [U] for 1SF
tags.best_day_max_share: [VP 1SF] none for passing the Evaluation (the 35% rule applies only to Master Monthly 100% payouts)
tags.min_trading_days: [VP 1SF] 'No minimum trading days and no time limit to pass'
tags.target_requires_flat: [U] the target basis (balance or equity, flat or not) is not stated; assumed only closed results count (conservative)
tags.breach_inclusive: [VP 1SF] official example 'Equity cannot drop to $103,790 that day': reaching the level is a breach
tags.day_boundary: [VP 1SF] 'resets at 00:00 Platform Time (UTC+3)'; DST behaviour [U]. Default 'ny_17' (zeno's MT5 server clock reads New York + 7 h, i.e. UTC+3 in US summer, UTC+2 in winter; FundingPips' summer and winter auto-close windows match a server that shifts); sensitivity 'utc_plus3' (fixed 21:00 UTC)

unmodelled: [VP 1SF] 20-lot hard cap per trade (zeno_pullback_v1 never comes near it at 0.5% risk)
[VP 1SF] inactivity breach after 30 calendar days with no completed trade
[VP 1SF, RTP] 'purposely trading during news and speeches' is banned in both phases with no numeric threshold; the rule's own news blackout (D20) is the only proxy
[U] swaps and commission inside the daily loss: not stated; the evaluator counts all costs (conservative)
[VP 1SF] Master: news window, profit deduction, daily auto-close, dynamic metals leverage, Striking System ([U] applicability) are handled by the strategy's Master variant, not by these rules
_meta.warning: Rule sheet verified on 2026-10-08 from FundingPips help pages that were being edited that day. The target basis and the Platform Time DST behaviour are [U]; the 'utc_plus3' sensitivity run covers the second.
